# Baba Travels & Tours

> Pakistan-based travel agency (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad; partner desk in Dubai) for air tickets, Umrah and Hajj packages, northern Pakistan tours, international holidays, visa assistance, hotel booking, car rental, airport transfers, intercity coach booking, corporate travel and cargo. Free quotes in about 30 minutes; prices in PKR; WhatsApp support 24/7.

## Key facts
- Umrah packages: from PKR 289,000 per person (14 nights, sharing), visa + flights + hotels + transport included
- Hunza Valley tour: 6 days from PKR 54,900 per person
- Dubai package: 4 nights from PKR 119,000 including UAE visit visa
- Payments: bank transfer, cards, JazzCash, Easypaisa
- Contact: +92 300 0000000 · info@babatravels.pk
